body.p: After . Owns src/collation.c, src/collation_internal.h, src/function_library.c, src/function_library_string.c, src/function_library_sequence.c, src/function_library_deep_equal.c, tests/collation_test.c. : codepoint, HTML ASCII case-insensitive, UCA URIs with fallback (simple-uca-fallback); collation-key, collation-available, collation; every collation argument through one resolver (FOCH0002 only for unknown URIs). deep-equal 4.0 options (fn-deep-equal, 120 failing), compare (204), duplicate-values (106). Done when fn-compare, fn-deep-equal, fn-duplicate-values ≥ 95% and the 100 FOCH0002 failures are gone. Spec: F&O 4.0 "Collations", "fn:deep-equal". Done 2026-10-17 (): src/collation.c (codepoint, Unicode and HTML ASCII case-insensitive, UCA fallback), one resolver, fn:collation, -available, -key, deep-equal 4.0 options. fn-compare 221 of 225 (98%), fn-duplicate-values 111 of 113 (98%), fn-deep-equal 327 to 395 of 449 (88%: 33 cases need function-item equivalence, Proposed for src/ir.c; 18 need functions of other packets). FOCH0002 failures 280 to 12, all in bodies of other parts (Proposed). XP40 26,170 to 26,510 passed.
